    11  /-!
    12  
    13  # Condensed Objects
    14  
    15  This file defines the category of condensed objects in a category `C`, following the work
    16  of Clausen-Scholze and Barwick-Haine.
    17  
    18  ## Implementation Details
    19  
    20  We use the coherent Grothendieck topology on `CompHaus`, and define condensed objects in `C` to
    21  be `C`-valued sheaves, with respect to this Grothendieck topology.
    22  
    23  Note: Our definition more closely resembles "Pyknotic objects" in the sense of Barwick-Haine,
    24  as we do not impose cardinality bounds, and manage universes carefully instead.
    25  
    26  ## References
    27  
    28  - [barwickhaine2019]: *Pyknotic objects, I. Basic notions*, 2019.
    29  - [scholze2019condensed]: *Lectures on Condensed Mathematics*, 2019.
    30  
    31  -/
    32  
    33  public section
    34  
    35  open CategoryTheory Limits
    36  
    37  open CategoryTheory
    38  
    39  universe u v w
    40  
    41  /--
    42  `Condensed.{u} C` is the category of condensed objects in a category `C`, which are
    43  defined as sheaves on `CompHaus.{u}` with respect to the coherent Grothendieck topology.
    44  -/
    45  abbrev Condensed (C : Type w) [Category.{v} C] :=
    46    Sheaf (coherentTopology CompHaus.{u}) C

    51  -/
